name: Economy status unit, single gang c/w keyswitch operated mode (auto/manual) switch and Status LEDs. Max. 8 per EP203
summary: Designed to connect to the EP203/CON Automatic Extinguisher Panel to provide remote system status indication via three LEDs.
description: Mounts on a standard UK single gang 25mm flush or surface back box.
8 economy status units per EP203/CON panel.

Network specification: Max. 8 EP211's per EP203 panel. Four wire connection (2 power, 2 data); Daisy-chain wiring. A 6K8 end of line resistor must be connected across the terminals of the last EP211 in the chain.

specs.label: Indicators
specs.value: Release Imminent; Manual/Automatic operation; Manual Only operation.

specs.label: Controls
specs.value: Operation keyswitch (Manual only or Manual & Auto).

specs.label: Product dimensions (mm)
specs.value: 87 W x 87 H x 35 D mm. Can be mounted on a standard UK 25mm single gang flush or surface back box.
